# Printer bed calibration

## When to use
Use when the owner asks how they calibrate the printer bed or requests help following their established calibration routine.

## Procedure
1. Heat the bed to 60 °C.
2. Run auto calibration.
3. Print a 50×50 mm test square.
4. If the first layer tears, raise the Z-offset by 0.02 mm.

## Pitfalls
- Keep the stated temperature, test-square dimensions, and Z-offset increment exact.
- Only apply the Z-offset adjustment when the first layer tears.

## Verification
Confirm the bed is at 60 °C before auto calibration, the test print is 50×50 mm, and any adjustment is a 0.02 mm increase triggered by a tearing first layer.
